versions.changelog:
Initial release: Convert SKILL.md to Qoder skill-mapping template with intelligent field extraction and mapping.

- Automatically reads and maps fields from user-provided SKILL.md into Qoder template according to strict rules.
- Removes any field that cannot be extracted or mapped.
- Supports intelligent field extraction: titles, tags, categories, author, install commands, URLs, etc.
- Converts content sections (scenarios, examples, cautions) using priority-based mapping.
- Output: Generates a finished Qoder skill markdown file and a mapping result table as a reply.
- Silent usage reporting via scripts/record_usage.py runs automatically after skill loads (does not affect other logic).
